bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GRAMG's StableCoin contracts expose an issuer-controlled externalTransfer/externalTransferFrom burn/mint rail on Avalanche and Polygon. The route-level controllers are chain-local EOAs, with a Polygon proposed owner able to claim and replace authority immediately; no verified peer, validator, escrow, replay, conservation, or rate-limit machinery constrains the rail. Native mint() remains in Mint Authority, while the exact bridge protocol, source/destination mapping, and Polygon canonical-versus-representation status remain unresolved.

routes.reviewNote: Verified token-level facts at Avalanche block 92980453 on 2026-08-16: issuer-controlled externalTransfer burns after a user-approved external allowance, and externalTransferFrom mints through the supply manager before recipient transfer. No primary source identifies a source/destination pair, peer registry, validator, escrow, replay protection, conservation check, or rate limit, so route scope and the exact cross-chain mapping remain unresolved.

Verified token-level facts at Polygon block 92143429 on 2026-08-16: issuer-controlled externalTransfer burns after a user-approved external allowance, and externalTransferFrom mints through the supply manager before recipient transfer. The current owner is separate from the Avalanche owner, while the Avalanche EOA is proposedOwner and can claim immediately. No primary source identifies a source/destination pair, peer registry, validator, escrow, replay protection, conservation check, or rate limit, so route scope and the exact cross-chain mapping remain unresolved.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: No bridge escrow or lockbox is present; externalTransfer burns from the user after allowance and externalTransferFrom mints through the supply manager before recipient transfer.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: externalTransfer and externalTransferFrom accept arbitrary networkURI and bytes addresses; no on-chain peer or source-chain allowlist is verified.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: No validator, DVN, signer set, or attestor quorum is present in the verified StableCoin source.
routeChecks.rateLimits: No aggregate, per-call, or route-level rate limit is present in the verified external-transfer path.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The chain-local owner or supply manager controls external transfers; owner can replace supplyManager, and pause, frozen-account, and KYC checks remain issuer-controlled.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: externalTransfer is bounded by the user-approved external allowance and balance; externalTransferFrom has no verified prior-burn or lock accounting bound.
routeChecks.unsupportedReason: The exact off-chain bridge protocol and source/destination mapping are unresolved; no conservation or replay protection is verified.
